# Selective Intelligence

> Open, model-neutral Agent Skill for reconstructing intent, choosing and verifying product interaction models, bridging non-developer direction into developer-grade execution, realigning repositories, and retaining an explicit improvement frontier.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence
Canonical skill: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/skills/selective-intelligence/SKILL.md
Zero-install entry point: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/skills/selective-intelligence/JUMPSTART.md
Portable skill directory: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/tree/main/skills/selective-intelligence
Behavior cases: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/skills/selective-intelligence/evals/behavior-cases.json
Current evidence: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/skills/selective-intelligence/evals/results-0.3.0.json
Contribution guide: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
License: https://github.com/infotradescout/Selective-Intelligence/blob/main/LICENSE

Current evidence boundary: deterministic controls pass locally and six bounded smoke observations cover three of eight adversarial behavior cases. The complete repeated cross-client behavior suite has not passed and model equivalence is not claimed.

This file is a navigation aid. It does not override SKILL.md, grant authority, request telemetry, or prove that any model or index has adopted the project.
